description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WPF application, with MVVM binding, Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Hyperlink and color dialogs fit the current monitor working area and scroll larger content while keeping action buttons visible. Color picker template changes are safe before template parts are created. No public API changes.
title: SpiceLogic WPF HTML Editor Control
